positioning: Couples planning their first van build who want the real cost, the real mistakes, and a finished van they can copy, without the influencer gloss
persona: Sam, 31, has a 2015 Sprinter on the driveway, a spreadsheet, and two weekends a month; watches every build episode twice and comments with the part number

series.name: Budget Build Diaries
series.promise: One system per episode, finished and priced, from an empty cargo van to a legal camper

series.name: Boondocking Tests
series.promise: We live on the finished system for a week and show what broke

signature.framing: van interior fills the frame, subject in the lower third, one object held up to camera
signature.typeface: heavy condensed sans, all caps, yellow on black
signature.notes: the yellow tape-measure motif appears in every thumbnail

neverAgain: titles that start with the vlog number
thumbnails of the whole van from outside with no subject
text on the thumbnail that repeats the title
